Introduction
This document sets out the steps for the quarterly inspection of the automatic water fire extinguishing system on the main and auxiliary transformers.
The first draft was prepared by Eng. Ahmed Mohamed El-Mohtady Qamra, tested by Eng. Abdel Magid El-Henawy, reviewed by Eng. El-Said Shaaban Abdel Qader and Eng. Hossam El-Din El-Dify, approved by Eng. Magdy Okba, General Manager, and approved by Eng. Ahmed Abdel Magid Sawan, Head of Nubaria Power Station Sector. It was reviewed and the document was approved by Chemist Ibrahim Youssef Youssef Soliman, Occupational Safety and Health Inspector in the Inspection and Quality Control Sector, and the document was approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Galil Ahmed, General Manager of Technical Inspection at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company and the company's coordinator for the Maintenance Procedures Information System, and certified by Eng. Mohamed Naguib Abdel Hay, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company.
Safety Precautions
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority; those carrying out the maintenance must hold an Occupational Safety and Health category card.
Fence off the place to define the work area and put up warning signs.
Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet, safety shoes, overalls, gloves, ...).
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority; those carrying out the maintenance must hold an Occupational Safety and Health category card.

Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet, safety shoes, overalls, gloves, ...).

Procedure to be Carried Out
1. | The steps are carried out for the transformer, whether in service or out of service
2. | Make sure the main parts of the system are observed
3. | Make sure the fire extinguishing system is in its normal operating mode through the fire panel
4. | Make sure the gauges are in good condition
5. | Make sure the main start valve is closed
6. | Make sure of the supply source water pressure
7. | Make sure of the water pressure in the system
8. | Make sure the alarm is sound and working
9. | Inspect the main drain valve
10. | Inspect the auxiliary drain valve
